description: Conversational evaluation dataset for RAG-based Cultural Events Chatbot - Emphasis on multi-turn dialogues, context retention, and clarifying questions

schema_notes.conversations: Multi-turn test scenarios grouped by session_id. Each turn builds on previous context.
schema_notes.single_queries: Standalone queries for testing specific functionality (reduced from v2.0)

turn_types.initial: First query in a conversation - establishes context
turn_types.refinement: User modifies previous request (e.g., 'actually, make that February')
turn_types.follow_up: User asks about specific results (e.g., 'tell me more about the first one')
turn_types.topic_shift: User changes to entirely new topic within same session
turn_types.clarification_response: User responds to chatbot's clarifying question

context_retention_scoring.description: How to score context retention in multi-turn conversations

criteria.perfect: All relevant context from previous turns is correctly used
criteria.partial: Some context is retained but key details are missed
criteria.failed: Context is ignored or incorrectly applied

clarifying_question_scoring.description: How to score clarifying question behavior

criteria.appropriate: Asks relevant clarifying questions when query is ambiguous
criteria.over_clarifying: Asks for clarification when not needed
criteria.under_clarifying: Fails to ask when query is clearly ambiguous

topic_shift_scoring.description: How to score topic shift detection

criteria.correct: Correctly identifies when user shifts to new topic vs refines previous
criteria.false_positive: Treats refinement as new topic (loses context unnecessarily)
criteria.false_negative: Treats new topic as refinement (applies irrelevant context)
